Bad Experience with DXM and the Afteraffect
I stated off early in the day as so my trip would be early onset within the day. I started directly off by drinking two 118 ml bottles of cough syrup of the dollar general brand that had nothing but DXM cough suppressant in it at 15 mg per 5 ml. And the downed 4 boxes at 18 tablets a piece that contained 30 DXM hbr per tablet. Needless to say within an hour I was within the first plateau.
And not even within 4 hours I was peaking around a third plateau I cannot recall all my experiences but some. I felt like I was alone completely and my life was nothing at all. I felt that I wasnt real and I couldnt feel my self breathing and I felt like I had no heartbeat. I awoke multiple times through out the night feeling horrible like I was in a surreal nightmare. I will probably never do this substance again.
The main reason for this report is for my aftermath my foot is completely numb now and has been for 2 days in a row after using 2010mg of DXM I have not yet seeked a doctors attention but will be today.
